recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7572; future normative-status or conformance-language changes for updates.html should be handled under a later work-group decision or tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-7572 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked for business-specific details about when an update may be appropriate or disallowed, with the final resolution to add a reference from the HTTP update section to updates.html.
initial_application: Git commit 353196fb130ab6e3498efbe5e72ef9734e485039, the git-svn mirror of svn revision 6462, explicitly applied '#7572 - add reference to updates.html' by adding an HTTP update paragraph linking to updates.html. The target updates.html page was introduced earlier by the published FHIR-3858 work in commit 00a6a999bd097063257fe408e6f7b48cec778d12.
additional_context: The link text and page title have changed over time, but the current RESTful API page still links from the update interaction to 'Variations between Submitted data and Retrieved data' and repeats the reference near rejecting updates. The target page covers storage/retrieval variation, access permissions, data integration, trusted update sources, business logic, data loss risks, and mitigation. Later FHIR-24914 work added transaction-integrity expectations without reversing the FHIR-7572 reference.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source satisfies the seed resolution, and adding another duplicate reference or restating updates.html guidance would not change implementer understanding.
